streams.notes: Current (v1.2+) session store: Drizzle/SQLite WAL at opencode.db (+ -wal/-shm). Fixtures 1.18.22 keep journal_mode=WAL; redaction checkpoints into the main file so the committed db is complete. basic-chat uses the non-git `global` project; tool-use/resume init a git worktree so project.id is a hash and vcs=`git`. Conversational truth is message.data (role) and part.data (type); the event table is an append-only streaming log (session.created.1 / session.updated.1 / message.updated.1 / message.part.updated.1). credential/account tables exist and MUST-NOT-PARSE. Schema dump: sources/<version>.sqlite-schema.sql.
Provider credentials — MUST-NOT-PARSE; inventory only, excluded from harvests.
CLI/TUI diagnostic logs under Global.Path.log. Farm harvests log/opencode.log.
Pre-1.2 per-record JSON sessions (storage/session/<projectID>/ses_*.json). Both formats exist in the wild; current writer is SQLite.
Git worktree snapshots at snapshot/<project-hash>/<snapshot-hash>/ (HEAD, config, objects, index). Farm strips snapshot/**/hooks (git init template samples). Present only when the cwd is a git repo.
Headless stream-json stdout — corroboration surface captured by the farm, not part of the agent data root.
